combo_label: Emergency Services × Horses & Riding × Robin Hood

entries.clue: Pair of straps from bit to hands; let them go slack and you lose the steering
Quilted cover strapped on against a frosty night; indoors, a floor one
Nottinghamshire haunt of Robin's band, home to the ancient Major Oak
Ring of tape and officers holding onlookers back from a scene
Hard horn capsule at the bottom of the leg, rasped back every six weeks
Antlered quarry of the greenwood, or a groom's night out before the wedding
The Maid of the legend, sweetheart of the greenwood's chief
Bag on a stand feeding a vein; a patient in bed is said to be on one
Mendicant brother in a rope-belted habit; Tuck is the famously stout one
White hairs peppered through a dark base — strawberry, if the base is chestnut
Green-suited responder who reaches you first and starts treatment on the pavement
